# [Multishop] Error when updating "Schema of URLs" for a single shop

When multishop is enabled, updating the "Schema of URLs" for a single shop causes the following error:

```php
PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Adapter\Routes\RouteValidator::isRouteValid(): Argument #2 ($rule) must be of type string, bool given, called in D:\cms\Prestashop\_Github\PrestaShop-dev-9.1\src\PrestaShopBundle\Form\Admin\Configure\ShopParameters\TrafficSeo\Meta\MetaSettingsUrlSchemaFormDataProvider.php on line 100
Steps to reproduce
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cc9620d1-e40e-4295-9262-3b1337aeb9f3

## Étapes
1. Enable multishop.
2. Select a single shop context.
3. Go to Shop Parameters > Traffic & SEO.
3. Try to update one of the values in Schema of URLs.
4. Save the form.
